Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for human adenosine A2a receptor. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
